svg.title: VDAT overview diagram reconstructed as editable SVG
svg.desc: Inventory: left dashed Natural Data frame with three thumbnail images and ellipsis; central VDAT processing frame with adversarial perturbation, noisy image, adversarial geometry plot, vulnerability calculation box, vulnerability sample scores, data filtering, natural/adversarial train thumbnails and neural network; right top green dashed Vulnerability Calculation frame with adversarial geometry, margin stack, hard margins, soft margin transformation and vulnerability samples; right bottom blue dashed Data Filtering frame with vectors, probability calculation, equations, random threshold routing to natural and adversarial training samples. Spatial relationships follow the original: data flows left to right from natural data into VDAT, then to top and bottom explanatory panels.
